open_points.subject: effects.operation_element_conclusion
open_points.text: "...or not reached when the element has no NodeExecution yet (A11 rule 3)."
open_points.question: When an element has no NodeExecution yet but does have a requested approval, must the operation return waiting(owner_approval) or not_reached?
options: Return waiting with reason owner_approval and approval_id whenever a requested approval exists
Return not_reached whenever no NodeExecution exists, even if a requested approval exists
open_points.default_guess: Return waiting(owner_approval) if a requested approval exists; use not_reached only when neither NodeExecution nor waiting record exists.

open_points.subject: MCP read_spooled_file / store.read_value_bytes
open_points.text: "...names it by its identity — run_id, producer_node_id, map_index, attempt_number, producer_port, list_index — the lookup identity; its digest, size and media type only describe it..."
open_points.question: If the caller supplies digest/size/media_type that do not match the located SpooledFile record, should the call refuse or ignore those descriptive fields?
options: Validate descriptive fields against the stored SpooledFile and refuse on mismatch
Ignore descriptive fields entirely and use only lookup identity fields
open_points.default_guess: Ignore descriptive fields and resolve strictly by lookup identity fields.

open_points.subject: store.read_records
open_points.text: Relation section: "A call that passes other arguments is a defect of its caller and answers internal_error." Public op section: "### Errors: unknown_reference ..."
open_points.question: Is internal_error a required possible result of store.read_records for wrong relation arguments, or is unknown_reference the only allowed failure?
options: Allow internal_error for malformed relation arguments
Disallow internal_error here and force callers to prevent such calls completely
open_points.default_guess: Allow internal_error for malformed relation arguments.

open_points.subject: store.open_store
open_points.text: "### Errors: refused naming the lock held, a directory not private, or a symbolic link; the start stops."
open_points.question: For other startup failures during open (e.g., SQLite open/init I/O failure not covered by those checks), what result code must open_store return?
options: Return internal_error for non-check operational failures
Map all open failures into refused with a reason
open_points.default_guess: Return internal_error for operational failures outside the explicit refused checks.
